note: Where each villager's v3 frames (src/art-release-v3/npc/npc.<who>.*.png) were taken from. The ONE place that records it: tools/art_v3/import_npc_v3.mjs reads this file, checks the frames out of the commit named here (the same blobs: the pictures are never edited on this branch) and verifies the result. To replace a person, change its commit here and run `node tools/art_v3/import_npc_v3.mjs`; `--check` only verifies. state: "final" = passed the independent inspection; "provisional" = still being corrected by its artist, to be replaced. To replace the cook and the merchant (provisional) when their small fixes (the cloth, the pen, the fittings) land on gfx/v3-npc-b: put the new commit on their two lines and run the import.
